subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should PR #97448 remain open as the generated-media wake-false proof target, or should maintainers close it in favor of the split implementation and harness PRs?
rationale: The branch is intentionally broader than the likely landing boundary and the visible proof runner has not yet produced successful baseline/candidate media evidence.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep the draft open and rerun Mantis only after the trusted proof harness can start the generated-image marker scenario.

options.title: Close For Split PRs
options.body: Close this draft if maintainers want to review and land only #97275 and #97308 separately.

options.title: Use Combined Stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the landing boundary and accept that it combines implementation, proof harness, and stack-only alignment work.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and rerun Mantis only after the trusted proof harness can start the generated-image marker scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the central media completion recovery behavior that this PR changes.
